name: cb-probe
description: Local stdio MCP server for self-judging AI models against Compassion Benchmark's published probe items, unscored (JudgeEstimate) or as a scored run ending in a composite and band computed with Compassion Benchmark's own canonical formula (SelfRunScorecard). No network I/O, no provider SDK, no API key. official is always false in both artifacts -- never an official Compassion Benchmark result.
